 Xiaomi’s 11.11 Sale brings tech gifts for everyone this Christmas
 Get ahead on holiday shopping with the Xiaomi's 11.11 Sale!
 By Carlos Franco - November 9, 2026 As the holiday season approaches, Xiaomi Philippines has officially launched its much-awaited seasonal 11.11 Sale. Special promotional prices across smartphones, tablets, wearables, and smart home appliances will be available to help Filipinos start their Christmas shopping early. Designed to provide practical gifts for every budget, the nationwide campaign features discounts on Xiaomi, REDMI, and POCO devices across participating official online retail platforms.
 For connectivity on the go, the lineup highlights versatile smartphone deals suited for daily entertainment, productivity, and communication. The REDMI 17 (4GB+128GB), featuring a 7,500mAh battery, 6.9-inch display, and 50MP AI dual camera, drops to ₱11,999 from its original ₱12,999 price. Meanwhile, the durable REDMI Note 17 Pro 5G (6GB+256GB) is offered at ₱22,999, down from ₱24,999. POCO options include the accessible POCO C95 Pro starting at ₱10,999, alongside the mid-range POCO X6 starting at ₱21,999, POCO X8s at ₱22,999, and the flagship POCO F8 Ultra starting at ₱41,999.
 For students, creatives, and everyday multitaskers, tablet deals include the Xiaomi Pad 7 (8GB+128GB) at ₱18,999, reduced from ₱25,999, and the Xiaomi Pad 8 (8GB+128GB) at ₱21,999, reduced from ₱26,499. Fitness enthusiasts can take advantage of Lazada-exclusive wearable bundles, including the Xiaomi Smart Band 9 Active and REDMI Buds 6 Active set for ₱1,999, down from ₱2,528, as well as the REDMI Watch 5 and REDMI Buds 6 Active set for ₱5,299, down from ₱6,328. Both wearable packages also include a complimentary Xiaomi Mi Casual Daypack.
 Home upgrades featured on Shopee include the Xiaomi TV A 55 2026 for ₱19,999, down from ₱22,690, and the Mijia Front Load Washer 9kg for ₱19,999, down from ₱20,999. Additional Shopee offers include the Mijia Smart Air Purifier 6 Plus for ₱18,999 and two 10,000mAh Power Banks for ₱1,999.
 Shoppers can explore Xiaomi’s 11.11 deals through its participating official online stores, including Shopee-exclusive offers for Smartphones & Tablets while you can avail of the Home Appliances and AIoT devices here . Promotional prices, product availability, and bundled offers are subject to applicable terms and conditions.
